The '''Vanicus''' were an influential political dynasty that existed during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[104 ABY]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gabrel Treon]] mentioned the Vanicus in "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]," a history of the [[House Praji/Legends|Praji family]] that was published in the [[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Nathan O'Keefe]], the author of ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', intended the Vanicus to be a reference to [[Orley Vanicus]], a character who appeared the the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Blog-valinkenobi|14/comments">{{Blog|valinkenobi|14/comments|TTSP Endnotes: Volume 1}}</ref>
